diagnostics.title: Missing icon alternative text
diagnostics.why: Icons require a textual equivalent for narration and nonvisual use.
diagnostics.fix: Add a short, meaningful alt component.

diagnostics.title: Class slot definition is invalid
diagnostics.why: A class slot requires a bounded positive capacity and one supported swap policy.
diagnostics.fix: Correct the class slot using the generated class slot schema.

diagnostics.title: Class definition is invalid
diagnostics.why: A class must use a known slot, bounded weight, valid prerequisites, costs, and typed grants.
diagnostics.fix: Correct the class using the generated class definition and grant schemas.

diagnostics.title: Class synergy definition is invalid
diagnostics.why: A synergy requires at least two known classes and bounded globally unique grants.
diagnostics.fix: Correct the required class set and grant identities.

diagnostics.title: Class selection was denied
diagnostics.why: Unknown, disabled, inaccessible, conflicting, over capacity, unaffordable, or requirement blocked classes cannot be selected.
diagnostics.fix: Review the class preview blockers and submit a fresh current intent.

diagnostics.title: Class respec or swap was denied
diagnostics.why: A respec or swap requires current ownership, allowed policy, exact costs, and a matching preview.
diagnostics.fix: Request a fresh preview and resolve every blocker before confirming.

diagnostics.title: Selected class requires reconciliation
diagnostics.why: Reloaded slot capacity, prerequisites, or lineage no longer permits the selected class to remain active.
diagnostics.fix: Review the suspended class and publish or run an explicit migration only after preview.

diagnostics.title: Class entitlement projection is invalid
diagnostics.why: A malformed grant, resolver, source identity, or target would make class ownership unsafe.
diagnostics.fix: Use supported attribute, ability, spell, stage, tree access, or class access grants.

diagnostics.title: Named currency definition is invalid
diagnostics.why: Currency scope, initial value, and checked bounds must form one consistent contract.
diagnostics.fix: Use character scope and keep the initial value inside the declared minimum and maximum.

diagnostics.title: Player progression data is quarantined
diagnostics.why: Unknown, malformed, or unsafe persisted data cannot be projected without risking corruption.
diagnostics.fix: Export the quarantined evidence, restore a verified snapshot, or install a compatible migration.

diagnostics.title: Player progression data exceeds a safety limit
diagnostics.why: Unbounded NBT depth, entries, strings, arrays, or bytes can exhaust server resources.
diagnostics.fix: Restore a bounded snapshot or reduce the persisted payload before importing it.

diagnostics.title: Player progression data migration failed
diagnostics.why: The stored data version could not be transformed into the current attachment contract.
diagnostics.fix: Keep the migration shadow, restore a backup, and provide every required version step.

diagnostics.title: Persisted definition state is orphaned
diagnostics.why: Its definition is missing, incompatible, or lacks an explicit identity replacement.
diagnostics.fix: Restore the compatible definition or declare an unambiguous same-kind alias/replacement.

diagnostics.title: Pending offline operation is quarantined
diagnostics.why: The operation expired, exceeded a limit, or no longer matches its pinned definition.
diagnostics.fix: Review the retained evidence and enqueue a newly validated operation if appropriate.

diagnostics.title: Player data snapshot or export failed
diagnostics.why: The bounded attachment could not be written and verified atomically.
diagnostics.fix: Check world storage access and free space, then retry without modifying the source attachment.

diagnostics.title: Player data identity does not match its owner
diagnostics.why: Loading one player's attachment for another player could transfer progression or receipts.
diagnostics.fix: Quarantine the payload and restore data whose embedded UUID matches the attachment owner.

diagnostics.title: Invalid component specification
diagnostics.why: Unbounded or malformed presentation data is unsafe to render or synchronize.
diagnostics.fix: Provide a bounded localization key and fallback text.

diagnostics.title: Invalid component placeholder
diagnostics.why: Placeholder names and types must agree across locales and call sites.
diagnostics.fix: Declare each placeholder once with its canonical type.

diagnostics.title: Invalid stable identity
diagnostics.why: Persistence and references require an explicit, normalized namespaced id.
diagnostics.fix: Use a lowercase namespace:path id derived from the definition path.

diagnostics.title: Explicit id does not match its source path
diagnostics.why: A mismatch makes file renames and persisted identity ambiguous.
diagnostics.fix: Remove the explicit id or make it equal the path-derived id.

diagnostics.title: Invalid identity alias
diagnostics.why: Ambiguous, cyclic, or cross-kind aliases can corrupt reference migration.
diagnostics.fix: Use one acyclic same-kind old-id to new-id mapping.

diagnostics.title: Networking protocol or feature mismatch
diagnostics.why: A client and server cannot exchange authoritative state under incompatible contracts.
diagnostics.fix: Install matching ProgressiveSkills versions and reconnect.

diagnostics.title: Bounded network transfer was rejected
diagnostics.why: A chunk count, byte ceiling, timeout, decompression cap, or digest check failed.
diagnostics.fix: Reconnect; if the error repeats, inspect both endpoints for mismatched or malformed payloads.

diagnostics.title: Network intent revision is stale
diagnostics.why: Executing an intent against different definitions or player state could duplicate or misprice it.
diagnostics.fix: Wait for the targeted full resync, then submit a fresh intent.

diagnostics.title: Network intent rate limit exceeded
diagnostics.why: Unbounded client requests could consume server tick time or memory.
diagnostics.fix: Wait briefly and retry a single current intent.

diagnostics.title: Visible state resynchronization is required
diagnostics.why: A revision gap, out-of-order delta, unknown path, or digest mismatch broke continuity.
diagnostics.fix: Allow the bounded full-state transfer to complete before making another mutation.

diagnostics.title: Content-pack discovery failed
diagnostics.why: A pack root or source path could not be inspected safely.
diagnostics.fix: Use readable regular directories and files without symbolic links.

diagnostics.title: Invalid content-pack manifest
diagnostics.why: Pack identity, compatibility, dependencies, and policy must be known before definitions load.
diagnostics.fix: Correct pack.toml using the generated manifest schema.

diagnostics.title: Missing or incompatible pack dependency
diagnostics.why: Loading without a required compatible pack would leave unresolved content.
diagnostics.fix: Install a version matching the declared range or update the dependency declaration.

diagnostics.title: Content-pack dependency cycle
diagnostics.why: A deterministic load order cannot be produced from a dependency cycle.
diagnostics.fix: Remove one dependency edge and use explicit layered merge intent instead.

diagnostics.title: Content-pack identity collision
diagnostics.why: Two discovered packs cannot own the same stable pack identity.
diagnostics.fix: Assign one pack a distinct namespaced [pack].id.

diagnostics.title: Definition merge conflict
diagnostics.why: A collision without compatible explicit merge semantics would make load order ambiguous.
diagnostics.fix: Choose add, replace, merge, patch, or disable and satisfy that operation's preconditions.

diagnostics.title: Pack dependency contradicts precedence
diagnostics.why: A dependency cannot safely load first when its root tier or explicit priority says it must load later.
diagnostics.fix: Move the dependency to an equal/lower tier and priority, or raise the dependent pack's precedence.

diagnostics.title: Definition id is shared across kinds
diagnostics.why: Typed keys remain unambiguous, but identical ids across kinds make references and provenance harder to read.
diagnostics.fix: Give one definition a distinct path/id unless the shared spelling is deliberate.

diagnostics.title: No validated reload is staged
diagnostics.why: Publishing must use the exact snapshot that was reviewed during dry-run.
diagnostics.fix: Run /ps reload --dry-run, resolve errors, then publish that staged snapshot.

diagnostics.title: Staged reload is blocked
diagnostics.why: A snapshot containing structural errors cannot replace the live last-known-good registry.
diagnostics.fix: Run /ps validate, correct every error, and stage again.

diagnostics.title: Last-known-good recovery failed
diagnostics.why: Neither current content nor a verified recovery bundle could produce a safe live snapshot.
diagnostics.fix: Restore a valid pack source or a complete world backup and validate again.

diagnostics.title: Rule definition is invalid
diagnostics.why: A gameplay route must compile to one bounded deterministic transaction path.
diagnostics.fix: Correct the rule using the generated rule definition schema.

diagnostics.title: Rule trigger has no provider
diagnostics.why: A rule cannot run without one registered server side trigger provider.
diagnostics.fix: Use a trigger supported by the installed provider registry.

diagnostics.title: Rule matcher is invalid
diagnostics.why: Unknown prefixes or subject incompatible matchers cannot compile into a safe route table.
diagnostics.fix: Use a documented prefix supported by the selected trigger subject.

diagnostics.title: Rule stack group is invalid
diagnostics.why: Rules and literal multipliers in one group require one deterministic stack policy.
diagnostics.fix: Use one stack policy per stable group and unique multiplier ids.

diagnostics.title: Rule anti exploit policy is invalid
diagnostics.why: Cooldowns, rate caps, fake player policy, and repeat decay must stay bounded.
diagnostics.fix: Correct the anti exploit windows, caps, and fixed point multipliers.

diagnostics.title: Rule event was rejected
diagnostics.why: Dedupe, eligibility, cooldown, first time memory, fake player policy, or a rate cap denied the event.
diagnostics.fix: Inspect the bounded last XP explanation before changing the rule.

diagnostics.title: Unsupported schema version
diagnostics.why: Definitions must compile through a known, versioned contract.
diagnostics.fix: Use schema_version = 2 or run an available migration.

diagnostics.title: Unknown schema field
diagnostics.why: Misspelled or future fields cannot be interpreted deterministically.
diagnostics.fix: Use a documented field name for this schema version.

diagnostics.title: Duplicate schema registration
diagnostics.why: Two owners cannot define the same schema identity safely.
diagnostics.fix: Keep one registration or assign a distinct namespaced id.

diagnostics.title: Invalid source span
diagnostics.why: Diagnostics and provenance must point to a valid bounded source range.
diagnostics.fix: Use a normalized relative source and a valid half-open line/column range.

diagnostics.title: Invalid canonical value
diagnostics.why: Canonical IR accepts only bounded typed values and immutable collections.
diagnostics.fix: Compile the field to its declared canonical value shape.

diagnostics.title: Invalid icon specification
diagnostics.why: Icon kinds, references, fallbacks, and preview policy must form one bounded descriptor.
diagnostics.fix: Use a documented icon kind with the required namespaced references and fallback.

diagnostics.title: Definition schema is not available
diagnostics.why: Accepting a definition before its typed compiler exists would create false validation claims.
diagnostics.fix: Use a definition kind implemented by this build or wait for its feature phase.

diagnostics.title: Unsafe presentation content
diagnostics.why: Commands, URLs, selectors, NBT, and other interpreted content cross trust boundaries.
diagnostics.fix: Use the bounded ComponentSpec subset only.

diagnostics.title: Skill definition is invalid
diagnostics.why: A skill must have bounded levels, presentation, overflow policy, and typed progression fields.
diagnostics.fix: Correct the skill file using the generated skill definition schema.

diagnostics.title: Skill XP curve is invalid
diagnostics.why: Every rounded level cost must be positive, nondecreasing, deterministic, and fit checked long totals.
diagnostics.fix: Correct the curve type and values at the first reported invalid level.

diagnostics.title: Skill XP award is invalid
diagnostics.why: Negative, overflowing, stale, or unknown XP awards cannot mutate authoritative progression.
diagnostics.fix: Use a positive fixed point amount and a current enabled skill or custom source.

diagnostics.title: Skill attribute grant is invalid
diagnostics.why: Unknown attributes, operations, level ranges, or unsafe values cannot be projected atomically.
diagnostics.fix: Use a registered player attribute and a bounded supported operation.

diagnostics.title: Stored skill state does not match its XP coordinate
diagnostics.why: Cached level, highest level, bank, and source ownership must derive exactly from fixed point state.
diagnostics.fix: Reconcile the player against the current definition generation before gameplay resumes.

diagnostics.title: Malformed TOML source
diagnostics.why: Invalid TOML cannot compile into deterministic canonical data.
diagnostics.fix: Correct the reported file and field using a TOML-aware editor.

diagnostics.title: Content source exceeds a safety limit
diagnostics.why: Unbounded file counts, nesting, or bytes can exhaust server resources during reload.
diagnostics.fix: Split or reduce the pack so it stays within the documented hard ceilings.

diagnostics.title: Tree definition is invalid
diagnostics.why: A Core tree must be bounded, acyclic, single rank, and use valid same tree prerequisites.
diagnostics.fix: Correct the tree and node fields using the generated tree schemas.

diagnostics.title: Tree purchase was denied
diagnostics.why: Unknown, disabled, owned, unaffordable, or requirement blocked nodes cannot be purchased.
diagnostics.fix: Review the purchase blockers and submit a fresh intent against current state.

diagnostics.title: Tree refund was denied
diagnostics.why: A refund requires current ownership, exact historical cost evidence, and a matching cascade preview.
diagnostics.fix: Request a fresh refund preview and resolve every reported blocker before confirming.

diagnostics.title: Tree purchase is orphaned
diagnostics.why: Persisted purchase evidence no longer maps to the same tree node lineage.
diagnostics.fix: Restore a compatible definition or review the orphan before an explicit migration or refund.

diagnostics.title: Paid cost ledger is invalid
diagnostics.why: Missing, malformed, conflicting, or overflowing historical payment evidence prevents an exact refund.
diagnostics.fix: Restore verified paid cost records before allowing a purchase mutation or refund.

diagnostics.title: Transaction state revision is stale
diagnostics.why: Applying a plan to a different state revision could duplicate costs, rewards, or ownership changes.
diagnostics.fix: Refresh the target state, rebuild the plan, and submit it with a new idempotency key.

diagnostics.title: Checked balance mutation was rejected
diagnostics.why: A debit, credit, bound, or checked-arithmetic operation could not commit safely.
diagnostics.fix: Correct the amount or affordability condition and rebuild the complete transaction plan.

diagnostics.title: Transaction definition generation is stale
diagnostics.why: A plan cannot execute after its pinned gameplay definitions or semantic digest change.
diagnostics.fix: Rebuild the plan against the current live definition generation.

diagnostics.title: Persistent lifecycle ownership is invalid
diagnostics.why: Conflicting resolvers or malformed ownership would make effective values nondeterministic.
diagnostics.fix: Use one registered resolver for every source contributing to the same entitlement.

diagnostics.title: Transition action was rejected or failed
diagnostics.why: Transition actions run only on explicit edges and must pass bounded physical-adapter validation.
diagnostics.fix: Correct the target, payload, delivery policy, or capacity issue and submit a fresh transaction.

diagnostics.title: Exact transaction ledger is full
diagnostics.why: A transaction cannot proceed without durable idempotency or receipt truth.
diagnostics.fix: Increase the configured hard capacity or complete the planned persistence/archive maintenance.

diagnostics.title: Persistent projection failed
diagnostics.why: The source-resolved value could not be applied atomically to its physical target.
diagnostics.fix: Inspect the target adapter and retry only with a newly validated transaction plan.

diagnostics.title: Transaction rollback is unavailable
diagnostics.why: Transition actions or later mutations cross the safe reversible boundary.
diagnostics.fix: Rollback only the latest retained action-free transaction or apply an explicit compensation.
